name: inventory
summary: read the hardware inventory from a BMC and print it as YAML (reads only)

flags.name: address
flags.usage: address label for the fact file (default: endpoint host)

flags.name: bmc-ca
flags.usage: PEM file with the CA certificates that the BMC's TLS certificate must chain to

flags.name: insecure
flags.usage: skip TLS verification of the BMC (prefer --bmc-ca)

flags.name: node
flags.usage: node name for the fact file (default: derived from the endpoint host)

flags.name: system
flags.usage: system id to describe (default: the BMC's only system)
